summary.note_on_controllers_not_directly_importi: These controllers delegate to App\Integrations\PlatformSettings\PlatformSettingsApi or to Feature Handlers (ActivationHandler, SessionHandler, UserAccountHandler, CredentialHandler). The integration and handlers do import the relevant contract interfaces, so the dependency chain is intact at runtime — the controller body itself is integration-shape, not contract-direct.

findings.issue: Orphan contract: interface is declared but never bound in apps/api/app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php and never consumed by any HTTP controller or production handler in apps/api/Modules/Organization/Features/TemporaryAssignment/Handler/. Only one implementation exists (apps/api/Modules/Organization/Features/TemporaryAssignment/Query/DatabaseListActiveTemporaryAssignmentFacts.php:11) and is instantiated only by apps/api/Modules/Organization/Tests/TemporaryAssignmentTest.php:636. The Query directory is not autoloaded as a handler pipeline. The TemporaryAssignment API/console pipeline does not invoke it. Either wire it into AppServiceProvider and call it from the TemporaryAssignment expiration/handler pipeline, or delete the contract + implementation + Query directory.

Orphan contract: no production implementation; the only impl is an anonymous class inside apps/api/Modules/Documents/Tests/DocumentUploadCoreTest.php:491. Not bound in AppServiceProvider. Docblock references Organization as a future consumer, but no Organization feature imports it.

Contract has a production implementation (apps/api/Modules/Identity/Infrastructure/Security/LocalUsernameDenylist.php:9) and is consumed by apps/api/Modules/Identity/Domain/PasswordPolicy.php:17, but neither is registered in AppServiceProvider. Production wiring is therefore ambiguous: PasswordPolicy::fromConfig or any consumer that resolves UsernameDenylist via the container will fall back to the inline new LocalUsernameDenylist at PasswordPolicy.php:35 — so the contract is effectively unused in production. Bind it explicitly.

Orphan/dead contract: no production or test class implements this interface. Only referenced as an iterable type-hint in apps/api/Modules/Authorization/Infrastructure/Simulation/RegisteredAuthorizationSimulationFactsResolver.php:13, which itself default-constructs with an empty $providers iterable. Effectively dead: DecideAccessController.php:50 calls resolve() and always gets null.

Bound in AppServiceProvider.php:151 to ResolveAuthorizationSimulationFacts but $providers defaults to an empty iterable. No code anywhere instantiates it with provider instances, so the foreach loop at line 21 never executes. The simulation path through DecideAccessController.php:50 always returns null. Either remove the binding and controller code path, or wire real AuthorizationSimulationFactsProvider implementations for each resource type.

Contract not bound in AppServiceProvider. One production implementation exists (apps/api/Modules/Documents/Infrastructure/Authorization/GrantedDocumentAuthorizationContext.php:11) plus a test impl. The production impl is never registered; consumers that ask the container for TrustedDocumentAuthorizationContext will fail with a binding-not-found error. Audit AuthorizedDocumentActor call sites and either register GrantedDocumentAuthorizationContext or remove the contract.

orphan_contracts_summary.verdict: Orphan — interface exists but is never bound in AppServiceProvider and never consumed by any HTTP controller or non-test handler.
Orphan — only an anonymous test class implements it; no production impl or binding.
Unbound production contract — implementation LocalUsernameDenylist is never registered in AppServiceProvider; PasswordPolicy falls back to inline instantiation.

unbound_production_impl_summary.verdict: Contract interface is implemented by GrantedDocumentAuthorizationContext but neither the contract nor the impl is bound in AppServiceProvider.

evidence: apps/api/routes/web.php registers 102 route entries (lines 114-305); every Route::get/post/put/patch/controller target resolves to a concrete controller class (only Controller.php is the unused abstract base class).
All 101 concrete controllers in apps/api/app/Http/Controllers/, apps/api/Modules/*/Http/, apps/api/Modules/*/Features/*/Http/ have at least one route binding.

54 of 60 contract types are bound in apps/api/app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php with a concrete implementation; remaining 6 are either internal DTOs (AccessDecision, AccessProjection, RecordFacts, AuthorizationResourceReference, CapabilityCatalog, RuleContext, RuleSpec, WorkflowSourceReference, PrincipalContext, EffectiveBusinessDay, SessionTransport, TrustedRequestBindingContext, PreAuthThrottleDecision) or unbound (see orphan_contracts_summary and unbound_production_impl_summary).
Cross-check via grep -rln 'implements <Contract>' confirms every bound contract has at least one production implementation.

Five contract files are flagged high/medium severity: ListActiveTemporaryAssignmentFacts (orphan), AuthorizationSimulationFactsProvider (dead), CleanSpreadsheetParser (test-only), UsernameDenylist (unbound impl), TrustedDocumentAuthorizationContext (unbound impl).

RegisteredAuthorizationSimulationFactsResolver is the only contract handler that is bound but operationally dead because its $providers iterable default-constructs empty (apps/api/Modules/Authorization/Infrastructure/Simulation/RegisteredAuthorizationFactsResolver.php:13). DecideAccessController.php:50 thus always receives null from this resolver.
